idea-plugin.name: Log4JB
idea-plugin.description:
Log4JB is the spiritual successor to the excellent Log4e plugin for the Eclipse IDE. Log4JB makes it easy to add structured, standardized logging to your Java applications in IntelliJ IDEA. Using Log4JB, you can easily:
  • Declare a new logger instance for use within your class
  • Added method start/end log statements
  • Log the value of a selected variable
  • Add user-defined log statements at any point in your code, including any variables
Work on Log4JB is still in the early stages, but you can track progress and feature implementations on the plugin's GitHub repo.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
What's new in Log4JB v0.6.0:
  • Fixed duplicate log statements being inserted when "Log This Method" or "Log This Class" is invoked multiple times on the same method
  • Improved logger declaration to detect existing SLF4J logger fields regardless of field name
  • Hardened "Reapply Logging" to only modify statements on the actual logger field
  • All actions now register named undo commands for clearer Edit > Undo entries
  • Fixed "Log at this position..." action visibility and null-safety
  • Local variable detection now includes variables declared in nested scopes
  • Removed erroneous debug output from generic log action

action.description: Adds a private static final SLF4J logger field.
Adds start and end debug log statements to the current method.
Declares a logger and adds log statements to all methods in the class.
Adds a debug log statement for the selected variable.
Generates a user-defined log statement at the selected location
Replaces System.out.println() calls with logger.debug() statements.
Replaces System.err.println() calls with logger.error() statements.
Updates and regenerates existing log statements in the selected method.
Updates and regenerates existing log statements in the selected class.
Removes the logger field and all logging statements from the class.
